title: FATEFAITHCLUB by TINXH
body:
FATE/faith invites TINXH, artist, producer and DJ from Buenos Aires, Argentina. Their sound is characterized by latin rhythms, energetic beats and a strong pop sensitivity. They solidified their presence in the Buenos Aires scene through the "Popperazo!" party. In 2025, they released "Club Destroyers", a project driven by electroclash and hedonism.

They've also released multiple remixes on SoundCloud, such as "Soy La Más Mala De España" (bb trickz), "Tócame" (Six Sex, Dillom) y "$T. LOSER" de Slayyyter.
